title: acre-gui shows its render sharp, with zoom, pan and reload from disk
body:
`App::render` in `crates/acre-gui/src/app.rs` draws the scene at scale 1.0 and shows the texture with `shrink_to_fit`. A figure wider than the pane is scaled down and comes out soft, and nothing zooms or pans. The GUI reads its file once, so an edit made outside it is never shown. acre-4db16b is the clipping bug in the same view.

## Proposal

- Render at the window's pixels per point and at the zoom, so the image is drawn at the pixels it covers.
- Zoom with the scroll wheel about the pointer and with keys, pan by dragging, and fit to the pane on a key.
- Reload the file when it changes on disk and the buffer has no unsaved edits.
